reason: The single cited study (E1) directly supports all key premises: it shows Hf-rich phase precipitation at interfaces, unchanged room-temperature properties, and improved high-temperature strength/ductility peaking near 0.5 at% Hf, with no mention of density change. The evidence is accurately represented and specific to the proposed alloy system.
premises: Hf addition (~0.5 at%) induces fine Hf-rich interfacial precipitates in dual-phase refractory HEAs
These precipitates hinder dislocation motion and grain boundary sliding at high temperature
This improves high-temperature strength and ductility
